text:
Sara: @product quick intake — Lodestar reached out asking to pin LLaMA-4o to eu-west-1 for a May pilot. Requirements: 99.9% uptime SLA, sustained ~50 rps, median gen latency ~200ms for ~2k token sequences. They want fallback to a quantized LLaMA-3-small in other regions if EU capacity is constrained. Support ticket: https://redwood.ticket/LD-321

Anya: timeline + committed spend?

Sara: pilot start 2026-05-15, est 120k tokens/day initially, committed ~$25k/mo for pilot.

Ravi: note: need to confirm model license & export control for an EU-only pin. Also clarify data residency vs processing in other regions when fallback happens.

James: capacity check — current EU pool spare for large fp16 models is ~10% next month. 50 rps at 2k tokens will likely exceed that without reserved capacity. We can offer a dedicated slot but requires a capacity commit (quote needed).

Elena: from launch criteria POV: must pass perf experiments + regression evals against Lodestar's prompt corpus, complete SLA signature, and implement automated geo-fallback policy that respects data residency constraints (anonymization step if leaving EU).

Anya: prioritization question — strategic account or pilot-level?

Sara: Lodestar is a growing enterprise customer; this is a paid pilot with clear upsell potential but not yet enterprise-committed. They insist on EU-only pin for data residency; fallback is acceptable only if anonymized. They want the start date firm.

Ravi: operational risks: export control review time, tail-latency spikes during cold KV cache, and warmup costs. Recommend canary rollout: 10% traffic for 2 weeks, then expand.

James: ops proposal for implementation mapping and circuit-breakers:

James: - Primary: llama-4o (fp16), region=eu-west-1, dedicated pool
James: - Fallback: llama-3-small (int8), global fallback with anonymization step
James: - Canary: 10% for 14 days
James: - Circuit-breaker triggers: 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 gen latency > 1s for 5m

James: config snippet:```json
{
  "model":"llama-4o",
  "region":"eu-west-1",
  "fallback":"llama-3-small",
  "canary":"0.1"
}
```

Elena: I'll attach the eval checklist + SLA template to LD-321 and create an intake doc with rollout steps and compliance notes. Assigning ownership to product for backlog itemization.

Sara: tagging product owners — @James @Elena @Anya please confirm prioritization and whether we accept this as a P2 backlog item.

ops-bot: Ticket LD-321 updated: created backlog item PROD-8892 (assignee: product).

Anya: Ack. We accept as P2. Scheduling for backlog grooming next Tue to scope dedicated capacity quote and compliance timeline.

Sara: thanks — I'll reply to Lodestar with the plan: canary start, dedicated quote, and compliance check timeline.
